summary: The core coverage-wrapped pytest classification slice is implemented and the focused runtime, control, API, ruff, and mypy validations pass: pytest failures with coverage at or above threshold become PYTEST_TEST_FAILURE, coverage-only shortfalls remain COVERAGE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, both-facts failures prefer fixing tests first, retry prompts name failing tests, and API summaries/provenance expose failing-test evidence. One saved-plan detail remains incomplete: coverage report/gap details parsed from coverage output are not preserved by runtime collection.
gaps: Wire _parse_term_missing_gaps() into ValidationRunner._collect_coverage() so coverage command stdout/stderr produce ValidationCoverageResult.gaps and persisted coverage metadata when term-missing/report details are available, including coverage-wrapped pytest failures and coverage-below-threshold cases.

Add a runtime regression test proving _collect_coverage() preserves parsed coverage gaps/report details from coverage command output alongside failing_test_node_ids/evidence; current tests only cover the parser and metadata helpers, not end-to-end collection.
